# turingpi_node_usb (Resource)

Manages the USB configuration of a Turing Pi 2 node including the USB mode and routing.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "turingpi_node_usb" "node1_flash" {
  node = 1
  mode = "flash"
  bmc  = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mode` (String) USB mode: `host`, `device`, or `flash`.
- `node` (Number) Node number (`1`-`4`).

### Optional

- `bmc` (Boolean) Route USB through BMC. When `false`, routes through USB-A connector. Default: `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier.
